vulnerability.name: USN-8117-1
vulnerability.description: Kazuma Matsumoto discovered that strongSwan incorrectly handled EAP-TTLS AVPs when using the eap-ttls plugin. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause strongSwan to consume resources and crash, resulting in a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: strongSwan could be made to consume resources or crash if it received specially crafted network traffic.
